claim: A consolidation network whose structure is legible (observe), editable (edit), and durable (store/load/read/write) — a machine an LLM can engineer directly.
brain_child_source: recovered by replaying the LLM's logged edit sequence (iteration 18 of run 1) from the baseline

honest_notes: The LLM made 155+ tool calls over 3 resume runs; its best discovered structure (0.2017) was saved at iter-18 of run 1.
A later over-edit collapsed the live structure to ~0.05; the best was recovered by replaying the logged edit sequence.
Raw-accuracy superiority vs a matched MLP is NOT settled: a separate 8-config sweep found consolidation wins only 2/8 configs on raw next-char accuracy, though capability-per-synapse is ~5x higher.
The durable claim is: the structure is bytes-on-disk, editable by an LLM, and saves/loads exactly.
